text:
jess: Heads up — customer org 'acme-rl' reports a sudden flurry of KMS decrypt errors after we rotated their tenant key alias a few hours ago. Errors = AccessDenied / MissingEncryptionContext. They see ~10% of requests failing, spike in support tickets.

samir: ugh. which API path is failing?

jess: primarily /v1/private/decrypt (proxyed through tenant-proxy). Stack trace from their SDK: 
```
ClientError: An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the Decrypt operation: Access denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/xxxxx
```
Also some logs show MissingEncryptionContext on decrypt attempts that previously had a context.

mike: @jess can you paste a truncated cloudtrail decrypt event for one failing request? need to see if encryptionContext made it to KMS.

jess: pasted below (redacted):
```
Decrypt
userIdentity: assumed-role/tenant-proxy-role
requestParameters:
  ciphertextBlob: <<snip>>
  encryptionContext: {}  # empty on failing events
```
Working events show encryptionContext: {"tenant":"acme-rl","env":"prod"} 

anya: so the proxy is sometimes stripping the context. We saw header-length truncation bugs before where the proxy maps encryptionContext -> HTTP header and it gets truncated by ALB.

support-bot: +1 to checking proxy mapping. Also account-level policy could deny Decrypt if context doesn't match - we use context-bound grants for multi-tenancy.

mike: repro plan — can we reproduce in staging by swapping their alias to new key and traffic through tenant-proxy? If we can trigger decrypts with and without ctx we confirm the proxy.

jess: I already tried on staging: when I call the service directly (bypassing proxy) decrypts succeed. Through proxy, requests show blank ctx in CloudTrail.

samir: possible culprits: 1) proxy middleware accidentally serializes ctx into header "x-kms-ctx" and that header contains JSON causing commas to be escaped/stripped. 2) HTTP/2 -> ALB header size. 3) new env var in proxy build changed encoding.

anya: check the proxy commit from yesterday: 6f8a2b2 changed how we stringify encryptionContext (used urllib.quote previously, now using simple json.dumps). That could introduce spaces that ALB strips? odd but plausible.

jess: customer provided a failing curl sample: 
```
curl -X POST https://proxy.redwood.ai/v1/private/decrypt -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -H "x-kms-ctx: {\"tenant\":\"acme-rl\"}" -d '{"ciphertext":"..."}'
```
CloudTrail shows encryptionContext empty for that call.

mike: next immediate mitigations: 
- Rollback the proxy change if it's the likely cause (rollback PR 6f8a2b2).
- Add a temporary env var to force pass-through of encryptionContext in request body instead of header.
- Add a canary rule in infra to route a small % to a proxy with instrumentation.

infra-bot: deploy job #rel/tenant-proxy/357 queued by mike — ETA ~12m.

samir: longer-term: we shouldn't encode encryptionContext into headers. It's a map and can get large/nested. Use binary blob or include in request body to the internal decrypt service. Also add tests to simulate ALB header truncation.

anya: quick checklist for support runbook: 
1) Confirm CloudTrail decrypt events show empty encryptionContext.
2) If empty, check tenant-proxy commit history and env vars (look for stringify changes).
3) Reproduce via staging by bypass/proxy comparison.
4) If repro matches, rollback proxy and notify customer.
5) Audit grants for the new key — ensure tenant-proxy role still has a grant that does NOT rely solely on encryptionContext (fallback grant) to avoid total outage during rotation.

jess: I've started the rollback and opened a support ticket to ACME. Informing them we'll do a staged rollback and verify.

mike: I'll take ownership of the postmortem. Need these artifacts: failing cloudtrail events (3-5), proxy config at time of rotation, commit diff, key policy, and grant IDs.

manual: also check CloudFront/ALB WAF rules that might mutate headers (happened before).

support-bot: Suggested customer messaging template: "We've identified that an internal proxy change caused intermittent stripping of KMS encryption context after your key rotation. We're rolling back and will verify decrypt success; no data loss is expected." Use empathetic tone.

jess: After rollback confirm: 1) CloudTrail now shows encryptionContext present; 2) customer API errors drop to baseline. I'll post updates.

mike: add a post-incident task: add an integration test that performs KMS encrypt/decrypt across full stack including ALB to catch header edgecases.

anya: FYI: Also check if grants for the new key were created using rotation window — there was a race in the grant service that sometimes delays grant creation by ~30s after alias swap. If proxy removes ctx during that window, decrypt will fail. So two orthogonal issues: header stripping + grant timing.

jess: noted. I'll ask infra to surface grant creation latency metrics.

samir: Thanks all. I'll monitor the deploy and ping #eng-infra once rollback completes. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy job #rel/tenant-proxy/357 succeeded — rollback complete.

jess: quick verification — CloudTrail decrypt shows encryptionContext present on the next 50 events. Customer confirms error rate returned to normal. Closing loop.

mike: great. capturing notes for postmortem. Assigning to me and samir for root cause analysis.

anya: going to file a follow-up to add test + change encoder to base64-safe header or body passthrough.

jess: thanks team. Filed support ticket update to ACME. :white_check_mark:
